name: Ahmed Maher
title: Flutter Team Lead
summary: Flutter engineer with 6+ years building cross-platform mobile products and 3 years leading a delivery team. 42 apps published to Google Play and the App Store across e-commerce, booking, trivia and business. Works end to end — architecture, state management, API and Firebase integration, store release and post-launch maintenance — with a bias toward clean architecture and code the next developer can maintain. Prior 15-year career as an oilfield data engineer across eight countries.

bullets: Lead the Flutter team across concurrent client apps, owning architecture decisions, code review standards and the release calendar.
Deliver large-scale e-commerce and gaming apps end to end — first build through store review, launch and post-release maintenance on both Google Play and the App Store.
Standardised the team on a shared BLoC and clean-architecture baseline, so features move between developers without a rewrite.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers through code review and pairing, and run the team Git branching and Trello workflow.
Built and maintained retail and logistics apps for Android and iOS, including the Stock Client ordering app and Stock Delivery driver app.
Improved app responsiveness through API pagination, image caching and reduced widget rebuilds.
Integrated REST APIs and Firebase — authentication, push notifications and crash reporting — across production apps.

experience.location: Egypt · Qatar · KSA · Spain · Ghana · Kuwait · Iraq · Malaysia
bullets: Designed, managed and analysed large oilfield datasets for drilling and production operations on multinational projects across Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Spain, Ghana, Kuwait, Iraq and Malaysia.
